steps.code:
# Let's fetch all habit log notes and extract the ate_homemade_meals status for each day.
# We'll store results in a list of (date, status) tuples.
habit_data = []
for note in notes:
    note_id = note["note_id"]
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
    content = note_detail["content"]
    # Parse the line for ate_homemade_meals
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ate_homemade_meals:"):
            status = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip().lower()
            # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
            title = note_detail["title"]
            date_str = title.split("--")[1].strip()
            habit_data.append((date_str, status))
            break

# Print to verify
print(habit_data)

steps.code:
# Let's fetch all pages of notes and collect all habit-tracker notes.
all_notes = list(notes) + list(more_notes)
page_index = 2
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Filter habit-tracker notes
habit_notes = [n for n in all_notes if "habit-tracker" in n.get("tags", [])]
print(f"Total habit-tracker notes: {len(habit_notes)}")
# Print titles to see date range
for n in sorted(habit_notes, key=lambda x: x["note_id"]):
    print(n["note_id"], n["title"])
